cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW141, destination Beijing, estimate GUPAD 20, level 8900m, TYN 35, next ISGOD, contact Beijing Control, report in cloud at 10100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是英航141，目的地北京，预计到达GUPAD 时间20分，高度8900米，TYN时间35分，下一个点ISGOD，联系北京区调，报告在10100米云中。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141 at 10100m in cloud, estimate GUPAD 20, maintaining 8900m, TYN 35, next ISGOD.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，英航141，高度10100米云中，预计到达GUPAD时间20分，高度8900米，到达TYN时间35分，下一点ISGOD。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing Control, previous aircraft have required diversions right of track due to weather, please advise if you require the same.[Meteorological radar shows that you are fine at this stage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京区调，前机因为天气原因要求改航至原航路右侧，如果有相同需求请通知。【气象雷达显示当前阶段状况良好。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，英航141。（气象雷达显示当前阶段状况良好。）

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing roger, contact me if require deviation.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京收到，如果需要改航联系我。

cards.audioText: There is CB ahead of you, request deviation 5 miles right of track.
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机前方有积雨云，请求右偏航5海里。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, request deviate/offset 5 miles right of track due to CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，英航141，由于前方积雨云，请求右偏航5海里。

cards.audioText: BAW141, deviate 5 miles right of track approved.
cards.referenceText: 5 miles right of track approved, thanks, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以右偏航5海里，谢谢，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, traffic information, detect primary radar signal at 1 o'clock, 50 kilometers, northwest bound, altitude unknown, we are unable to communicate with the aircraft.[Tell the controller that your TCAS has no indication of that aircraft, and confirm whether the traffic is in conflict with you.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，活动通报，探测到1点钟方向有一次雷达信号，距离50千米，向西北飞行，高度未知，我们无法和该飞机取得联系。【告知管制员飞机上的TCAS系统未显示该飞机，并确认该交通是否和你有冲突。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, we do not have TCAS indication, confirm that the unidentified aircraft will not be in conflict with us, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，TCAS上没有显示，确认该不明身份的飞机是否和我们有冲突，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, the aircraft is currently parallel to your track. You are closing on that aircraft, report sighting. [Tell the controller that you are crossing cloud and you can't see the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，该飞机目前与你处于平行航道，你离它越来越近，能见报告。【告知管制员你正在穿越云层，无法看到该飞机。】
cards.referenceText: We are crossing cloud. Negative contact with the aircraft, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们在云中穿梭，无法看见该飞机，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing Control, probable false signal, proceed normally.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京区调，可能是错误信号，继续正常飞行。

cards.audioText: You suffered lightning strike, make a distress call and request descent to 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: 遭遇雷击，发送遇险信号，请求下降4200米。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, BAW141, lightning strike, request descent to 4200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，北京区调，英航141，雷击，请求下降4200米。

cards.audioText: BAW141, descend to 4200m, report conditions.[You are checking and now suspect navigation system is malfunctioning.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，下降4200米，报告情况。【你正在检查，导航系统似乎发生故障。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200m, we are checking the navigation system, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4200米，我们正在检查导航系统，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing roger, when ready, advise intention.[You lost directional indication, if weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京收到，准备好时通知意图。【你失去了方向指示，如果天气允许，请求雷达引导至北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: If weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport due directional indication failure, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果天气允许，由于航向指示失效，请求导航至北京机场，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing roger, Beijing CAVOK, your position is 25 miles northeast of VYK on a heading of about 070, expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京收到，北京CAVOK，你的位置是VYK东北25海里，航向大约070，预计向左稍微偏转5海里。
cards.referenceText: Expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向左稍微偏转5海里，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, this is Beijing Approach, descend to 1800m on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京进近，下降修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道36左，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, you are 15 miles to touchdown on runway 36L, descend to 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，距离跑道36左接地点15海里，下降900米。

cards.audioText: BAW141, position 10 miles northeast of the field, 3 miles north of the extended center line of runway 36L, a correcting heading won't be necessary, descend to 600m, report visual.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，位于机场东北10海里，跑道36左延长线南部3海里，不需要修正航向，下降600米，能见跑道报告。
cards.referenceText: Position 10 miles northeast of the field, 3 miles north of the extended center line of runway 36L,, descend to 600m, report visual, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 位于机场东北10海里，跑道36左延长线南部3海里，下降600米，能见机场后报告，英航141。

cards.audioText: Tell the ATC that you have sighted the field.
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员你可以看到机场】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW141. field in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，英航141，看见跑道了。

cards.audioText: BAW141, roger, cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, you are number one, contact Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，收到，可以目视进近，加入跑道36左五边，你第一个着陆，联系塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, No.1, 118.1, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以目视进近，加入跑道36左五边，第一个，118.1，英航141。
